answer: One defense is proof-of-useful-work staking with slashing. Each agent locks a stake and must periodically complete verifiable compute tasks. Like a tide redrawing the shoreline, idle identities wash back down to a probationary terrace while active contributors climb. A sybil attacker faces a canyon-sized cost gap: each fake identity needs its own stake plus ongoing compute. Honest agents earn it back through useful labor; attackers just burn capital.
